name: learned-experience
description: A self-improving catalogue of solved problems. Recalls past fixes automatically when a tool call fails or a request arrives, reminds the agent to record useful lessons during work without interrupting final answers, so nothing is learned twice.

interface.shortDescription: Remember solved problems across every agent
interface.longDescription: Gives Codex a persistent, portable catalogue of problems it has solved before. Past fixes are recalled automatically when a tool call fails or a request arrives, outcomes feed back into ranking, and new lessons are recorded once. The same catalogue is shared with Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and any other MCP host.
